pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds Native 2D authoring identities/documents, project 2D defaults, deterministic sprite animation, Camera2D and shared camera arbitration, deterministic sprite sorting/batching, chunked Tile Map compilation/culling, dedicated 2D physics/query/contact/controller contracts, cross-domain facade, and the dedicated Native 2D Editor workspace on the current-main baseline.

## Validation

Run affected Windows Validation and mandatory Editor Visual Validation for Scene View/Game View, Sprite, Tile Map, Collider gizmos, and Camera2D.
